meta.title: OpenCI - The Open Source CI/CD Service, Affordable for Everyone.
meta.description: OpenCI is an open-source CI/CD service that anyone can use. We offer affordable, flat-rate monthly pricing so that anyone can use CI/CD.

introduction.heading: Democratize CI/CD with affordable pricing.
introduction.lead: Today's CI/CD pricing is too expensive.
introduction.paragraph1: CI/CD is an essential tool for software development. However, the pricing for traditional CI/CD services is prohibitively expensive for many software projects. While there is a free tier, and OSS projects get unlimited usage, in most cases normal usage exceeds the free tier, and not everyone develops open source software.
introduction.paragraph2: Other CI/CD services are trying to solve this problem. Some offer machines at 1/10th the price, while others provide faster machines—each company has its own approach. However, almost all of these services use pay-as-you-go pricing. This means you won't know the actual cost until the end of each month. Rather than making CI/CD accessible to everyone, these services seem more tailored to enterprise companies.
introduction.paragraph3: That's why we offer affordable, flat-rate monthly pricing so that anyone can use CI/CD. Start with our free plan—60 minutes of build time per month at no cost. When you need more, upgrade to our Basic plan at just ¥980/month for unlimited builds. Need parallel execution? Add concurrent builds for ¥2,000/month each. If you find a more affordable service than ours, please let us know—we're always striving to provide a better service.

bento.heading: Start running your builds in 5 minutes. Just 3 steps.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.description: Sign up for free on the OpenCI dashboard. No credit card required.

step2.title: Connect GitHub
step2.description: Install the OpenCI GitHub App to link your repositories. Select which repos to build.

step3.title: Create a workflow
step3.description: Pick a template or write your own. OpenCI uses GitHub Actions syntax—your existing Actions just work.

items.name: Additional Concurrent Build
items.description: Run multiple builds simultaneously. Add as many as you need to your Basic plan.

items.question: What counts as build minutes?
items.answer: Build minutes are measured from the moment your workflow starts executing until it completes. Queue wait time is not counted. Each build job is tracked independently.

items.question: What happens when I reach the free plan limit?
items.answer: When you reach 60 minutes in a billing cycle, new builds will be queued until your minutes reset at the start of the next month. You can upgrade to the Basic plan at any time for unlimited builds.

items.question: What does "concurrent builds" mean?
items.answer: Concurrent builds determine how many builds can run at the same time. With 1 concurrent build, jobs run one at a time. Adding more concurrent builds lets multiple workflows execute in parallel, reducing wait times.

items.question: What platforms are supported?
items.answer: OpenCI runs on Apple Silicon Mac hardware. Your workflows use GitHub Actions syntax, so you can build iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, and any other macOS-compatible project.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.answer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your dashboard. Your plan will remain active until the end of the current billing period.

items.question: Is there a team or enterprise plan?
items.answer: We are working on dedicated support and development assistance plans. Join our Slack community or reach out to us for custom requirements.
